name: Quincy
summary: Recommended as an early-game CHIMPS starter. v57 gave him a Focus toggle at level 4 (more range and precise shots, slower attacks).

milestones.text: Rapid Shot ability: a burst of triple attack speed.
Focus toggle: trade attack speed for range and accurate shots.
Sees Camo.
Fires two arrows per shot.
Triple damage to MOAB-class.
Storm of Arrows: rains arrows over a big area.
Quadruple MOAB damage.
Three arrows per shot.
Stronger attacks and a much bigger Storm of Arrows.

bestFor: A cheap, flexible early-game hero who stays useful as MOAB damage in CHIMPS, especially with Berserker Brew and Stronger Stimulant.
tips: Set him to Strong before Storm of Arrows to drop it on blimps.
He can't hurt DDTs (Lead) without help: plan an MIB or Glue Strike for the late game.

pairs.note: Berserker Brew and Stronger Stimulant suit his many low-damage arrows.
Monkey Intelligence Bureau lets him hit DDTs.

name: Gwendolin
summary: Fire damage pops leads early; Heat It Up buffs nearby towers. Not covered by the wiki's strategy pages.

milestones.text: Cocktail of Fire: a burning patch on the track.
Heat It Up: every 40 attacks, a blast that gives nearby Monkeys fire damage.
Attacks set Bloons burning.
Two blasts per shot.
Firestorm: burns every Bloon on screen and buffs all Monkeys.
Can now damage Purple Bloons.
Heat It Up adds a layer of popping and extra Lead damage to buffed Monkeys.
Three blasts per shot.

bestFor: Strategies that need steady Lead popping against DDTs, and fast low-damage towers that benefit from Heat It Up. Her abilities answer the Ceramic rushes on rounds 63, 76 and 78.
tips: Place her just ahead of your main damage so Heat It Up triggers often.
Her flat pierce buff is strongest on high-damage, low-pierce attacks like Inferno Ring.

pairs.note: Inferno Ring gains the most from her pierce buff and fire passive.
Her fire-tower passive speeds Signal Flare too.

name: Striker Jones
summary: Support hero for CHIMPS; the favored pick for Mortar builds thanks to attack-speed and black-popping buffs (pairs with Pop and Awe).

milestones.text: Concussive Shell: a guided shell that stuns.
Bomb Shooters and Mortars attack 10% faster.
Black Bloons become weaker to explosions from all Monkeys.
Target Focus: Mortars aim at your cursor for 15 seconds.
Nearby towers gain range and 25% pierce.
Artillery Command: resets all Bomb and Mortar cooldowns.
Black Bloons are fully vulnerable to explosions.
Artillery Command also doubles Bomb and Mortar damage for 10 seconds.

bestFor: Bomb Shooter and Mortar strategies: he removes their Black Bloon weakness and speeds them up. His pierce buff also helps Spike Factories.
tips: Save Concussive Shell for stall-heavy rounds like 63.
At level 20, Artillery Command is a strong answer to rounds 98–100.

pairs.note: Removes the Black Bloon weakness of Pop and Awe and Artillery Battery.
Faster, Black-popping explosions.
His pierce buff helps Spike Factories.

name: Obyn Greenfoot
summary: Listed as a CHIMPS win-condition hero.

milestones.text: Druids and Skywardens in range gain pierce.
Brambles: a spiked bush on the track.
Totems that slow nearby Bloons.
Extra range for Druids of the Jungle and Wind Weavers, and bonus cash for Druids.
Druids and Skywardens in range gain Camo detection.
Wall of Trees: destroys Bloons that enter, then bursts into cash.
Magic Monkeys in range gain range and pierce.
Brambles pop 500 Bloons and hit every type.

bestFor: The best hero for Druid and Skywarden builds, and a beginner-friendly pick. His Jungle's Bounty cash buff rivals the money heroes.
tips: His Brambles and totems are random: don't rely on them for early Camo or slowdown.
Place him near as many Jungle's Bounties as you can when farming.

pairs.note: Pierce, Camo detection and extra Jungle's Bounty cash.
Pierce and Camo detection, plus path-specific buffs.

name: Rosalia
summary: Flexible ranged DPS; discounts Heli Pilots and Aces in range.

milestones.text: Grenade weapon: switch between laser and grenades.
Scatter Missile ability.
Attacks faster the more Bloons are near.
Monkey Aces and Heli Pilots near her workshop get cheaper upgrades.
Hovers and can use Flight Boost to chase Bloons over the whole map.
Kinetic Charge: stores damage dealt to a Bloon, then detonates.
Lasers become plasma; grenades split into clusters.
The Anti-Bloon costs 30% less; triple Scatter Missiles.

bestFor: A versatile hero with a strong early game from her laser, best on maps with one active lane per round. Her discounts help afford Flying Fortress and Apache Prime.
tips: Most of her damage is the laser; use grenades for grouped cleanup.
Scatter Missile is excellent for clearing a tough clump.
Before level 13 only her enhanced 10th laser shot can hurt Lead; from 13 the laser is Plasma.

pairs.note: Cheaper upgrades for aircraft near her workshop.
Cheaper upgrades for aircraft near her workshop.

name: Captain Churchill
summary: Strong tank DPS and an Overclock target. Not covered by the wiki's CHIMPS or boss pages.

milestones.text: Armor Piercing Shells: shells pop Black and hit Ceramics harder.
Adds a machine gun.
Sees Camo.
MOAB Barrage: shells hit up to 10 blimps.
Stronger Armor Piercing Shells and MOAB Barrage.
Extra damage to Camo, Lead, Fortified and stunned Bloons.
Massive damage boost to all his attacks.

bestFor: An expensive early and mid-game carry that's strong on straight tracks. He levels slowly, so he falls off late without Energizer.
tips: Save up specifically to buy him.
Bring something else for the first Camo rounds: he only sees Camo from level 6.

pairs.note: Energizer helps him keep leveling.

name: Benjamin
summary: A primary boss-event hero: early cash snowballs your economy. The CHIMPS page says to avoid him (income is disabled). Normal/Freeplay: Snowballs income in standard games, especially if you reach him early.

milestones.text: Earns cash every round (more at levels 2, 8, 11, 15 and 17).
Biohack: four nearby Monkeys pop extra layers briefly.
Restores lives each round.
Banks earn more.
Bloon Trojan: a Bloon spawns no children and gives extra cash.
Syphon Funding: newly spawned Bloons drop a rank for a few seconds.
Trojan can hit BFBs and DDTs.
Syphon Funding lasts longer and gives triple cash.

bestFor: Easy income for casual games and boss events. In CHIMPS he earns nothing but Syphon Funding can delete dense rounds like 94, 96 and 98.
tips: Keep him away from income-per-pop towers and Paragons: Trojan steals their pops.
In CHIMPS, place him around round 80 just to reach level 10 in time.
He deals no direct damage; from level 18 his Trojan can target Camo Bloons.

pairs.note: Bank Hack boosts Monkey Banks.

name: Pat Fusty
summary: Big Squeeze grabs blimps; a good Overclock target from level 5.

milestones.text: Rallying Roar: nearby Monkeys pop an extra layer.
Occasional slap pushes Bloons back.
Hits stun Bloons.
Big Squeeze: crushes a blimp.
Longer stuns that briefly stop blimps.
Much more damage to Ceramics.
Big Squeeze grabs several blimps and stuns nearby Bloons.

bestFor: A very map-dependent hero whose value is stalling blimps and his level 3 buff. Best on maps where his short range reaches every path.
tips: Rallying Roar is best on fast, low-damage towers like The Tack Zone and Super Maelstrom.
Big Squeeze switches off his stun: save it for rounds with few blimps (60, 80, 85, 87, 97).

pairs.note: Rallying Roar on The Tack Zone or Super Maelstrom.
T-Rex deals extra damage to Bloons he stuns.
Berserker Brew makes his stuns much more frequent.

name: Ezili
summary: CHIMPS win-condition hero; MOAB Hex is a listed R40 answer. A fallback support hero in boss events. Normal/Freeplay: Her level 20 percentage damage is the Freeplay guide's main answer to late BADs.

milestones.text: Sees Camo.
Heartstopper: lets your Monkeys pop Purple and stops regrowth.
Much more damage to MOAB-class.
Sacrificial Totem: Camo detection and big buffs nearby (especially Wizards), at the cost of lives.
Strips Camo, Regrow and Fortified from small Bloons.
MOAB Hex: a blimp takes damage every second until destroyed.
Totem costs 1 life; can strip Camo from DDTs.
MOAB Hex works faster and can kill BADs.

bestFor: One of the best heroes in deep Freeplay thanks to MOAB Hex's percentage damage on BADs, and strong in CHIMPS by chaining Hex across blimps.
tips: Leave her on Strong.
Normal damage buffs do little for her; cooldown buffs (Energizer, The Final Harmonic) help a lot.

pairs.note: Energizer shortens MOAB Hex's cooldown.
The Final Harmonic shortens her cooldowns.
Sacrificial Totem buffs Wizards most.

name: Adora
summary: A fallback boss-event hero; Blood Sacrifice suits True Sun God setups against Elite tier 5 bosses. Normal/Freeplay: Blood Sacrifice powers the Sun Temple Freeplay build.

milestones.text: Long Arm of Light: big range and power boost that hits every Bloon type.
Two bolts at a time (more at 6, 8, 12, 14 and 18).
Blood Sacrifice: sacrifice a tower for XP and a temporary boost.
Ball of Light: a powerful energy strike.
Bolts pop an extra layer; stronger Ball of Light.
Greatly improved Ball of Light and stronger sacrifice buffs.

bestFor: Her Blood Sacrifice buff to Sun Temples and True Sun God in late game and boss events; in CHIMPS she has a very strong early game.
tips: Great Berserker Brew target before round 50; Overclock her at level 20.
You can sacrifice a mid-game carry to rush level 20 before round 98.

pairs.note: Blood Sacrifice powers up Sun Temples and True Sun God.
Berserker Brew early.
Overclock at level 20.

name: Etienne
summary: Drone DPS and global camo detection. Not covered by the wiki's strategy pages.

milestones.text: Nearby Monkeys gain range.
Drone Swarm: extra temporary drones.
Drones see Camo.
Two drones.
UAV: every Monkey gains Camo detection.
UCAV: a powerful combat drone for a while.
Nearby Monkeys gain 20% range.
The UCAV becomes permanent.

bestFor: Solid damage and support with a strong mid game. His level 8 map-wide Camo detection can replace a Radar Scanner.
tips: UAV doesn't help against Phayze's Radar Jam.
His level 16 range buff helps towers reach extra lanes (MOAB Domination, Popseidon, Desperados).
Avoid him with ability-based stall towers: the permanent UCAV ruins stalls.

pairs.note: Range buff lets MOAB Domination reach more lanes.
Range buff for path 1 and 2 Desperados.

name: Sauda
summary: Strong early-game starter, but not a solo carry: her bonus damage needs stuns, slows or damage over time (Relentless Glue, Dragon's Breath). Leaping Sword is spammable early boss damage in Boss Rush.

milestones.text: Sees Camo.
Leaping Sword Attack: a Lead-popping leap.
Extra damage to stunned Bloons; pops frozen.
Bleed damage over time.
Sword Charge: sweeps the whole track.
Extra damage to slowed or burning Bloons.
Damages every Bloon type.
Sword Charge sweeps three times.

bestFor: An easy, strong early game, best on Beginner and Intermediate maps and maps with overlapping lanes (Quad). Needs towers that trigger her bonus damage later.
tips: Pair her with stuns, slows and burns: Relentless Glue and Dragon's Breath.
Sword Charge trivialises rounds 63, 76 and 78.

pairs.note: Relentless Glue triggers her stun and slow bonuses.
Dragon's Breath burn triggers her damage-over-time bonus.

name: Admiral Brickell
summary: Support hero that buffs naval towers: pairs with Carrier Flagship, Pirate Lord, Destroyers and Subs. v57 reworked her: weaker early Naval Tactics and Pistol, water towers get +1 pierce from level 4, shorter Mega Mine.

milestones.text: Naval Tactics: big attack speed boost to nearby Subs and Buccaneers.
Water towers nearby gain pierce.
Naval Tactics lets them hit every Bloon type except Camo.
Sees Camo; Blast Chain ability.
Naval Tactics reaches all water towers and grants Camo.
Mega Mine: a stockpilable blimp-killing mine.
Sea Mines pop Black and remove Camo.
Naval Tactics becomes global.

bestFor: Water defenses: Buccaneers, Subs and amphibious towers on water. Naval Tactics is burst damage and Mega Mines delete blimps.
tips: Mega Mines can be stockpiled across rounds.
From level 8, amphibious towers on water (Symphonic Resonance, Popseidon, Absolute Zero) get Naval Tactics too.

pairs.note: Naval Tactics on Destroyers and Monkey Pirates.
Naval Tactics and pierce on fast-firing Subs.
Amphibious towers on water benefit from level 8.

name: Psi
summary: CHIMPS is his favored mode: instakills MOABs at level 14 and DDTs and ZOMGs at 20. He never targets BADs or Boss Bloons, and pairs poorly with Perma-Spike stalling. Normal/Freeplay: Can't damage BADs, so the Freeplay guide says to avoid him.

milestones.text: Destroys one Bloon at a time anywhere on the map; sees Camo.
Psychic Blast: a long stun nearby.
Can destroy Lead.
Can destroy Ceramics.
Targets two Bloons at once.
Psionic Scream: throws Bloons into chaos and removes huge RBE.
Can destroy Purple.
Destroys MOABs (BFBs at 16, DDTs and ZOMGs at 20).

bestFor: Advanced and Expert maps in CHIMPS: he ignores obstacles and levels faster there, and deletes RBE in the mid game.
tips: Level 20 needs Energizer to reach naturally.
He ruins end-of-round stalls, so he's not ideal with Perma-Spike.

pairs.note: Energizer to reach level 20.

name: Geraldo
summary: A primary boss-event hero (Rare Quincy Action Figure funds early farms; Blade Trap handles Bloonarius bleed). Support hero in CHIMPS, paired with Comanche Commander. Normal/Freeplay: Recommended on every standard map (the Rare Quincy Action Figure funds early farms), but the Freeplay guide says to avoid him.

milestones.text: Shop: turret, nails, idol, pickles.
Rare Quincy Action Figure: grows in value the longer you hold it.
See Invisibility Potion: temporary Camo for one tower.
Fertilizer: boosts Banana Farm output.
Rejuv Potion: resets cooldowns and restores lives.
Genie Bottle: a plasma Genie for two rounds.
Paragon Power Totem and a full shop restock.

bestFor: Boss events (Paragon Power Totems and efficient income) and Least Tiers. Flexible in every stage but hard to master.
tips: Don't overspend on items; learn their value in casual games first.
Buy the Rare Quincy Action Figure early for a big payout later.
He can't pop Lead himself; from level 8 the Gerry's Fire item gives a tower fire damage.

pairs.note: Fertilizer boosts farms.

name: Corvus
summary: CHIMPS win-condition hero; Ancestral Might is a listed R40 answer.

milestones.text: Haunts Bloons for mana; his Spirit attacks anywhere; learns Spear, Nourishment and Repel.
Soul Harvest; learns Echo and Haste.
Learns Frostbound, Aggression and Vision (Camo while casting).
Spirit Walk to reposition; learns Ancestral Might and Malevolence.
Dark Ritual; learns Recovery.
Learns Overload.
Can haunt blimps.

bestFor: CHIMPS and Half Cash: his spells save a lot of cash if used well. Best on maps with one active lane per round.
tips: Echo is essential for chaining spells on hard rounds.
Set him to Close on multi-lane maps to stop him chasing.
Keep a backup cleanup tower (Spiked Mines, Perma-Spike) for spell mistakes.

pairs.note: Perma-Spike or Spiked Mines as a safety net.

name: Silas
summary: CHIMPS win-condition hero that supports Ice Monkeys (range, Ice Fragments, tier 5 discounts) and is immune to Blastapopoulos overheating. His abilities do nothing to BADs.

milestones.text: Ice attacks that rime, then freeze, then shatter Bloons; slowing aura; sees Camo.
Ice Monkeys nearby gain orbiting ice fragments.
Frostbite: hits every Bloon type for a while.
Ice Walls on the track push back and freeze.
Frozen Cascade ability.
Frozen Burial: freezes and damages every Bloon.
Cheaper Ice Monkey tier 5s and a fourth Ice tier 5.

bestFor: Ice Monkey builds. His slowing aura and Camo detection make early placement easier on Flooded Valley and #Ouch.
tips: His early game is slow and many early towers can't pop frozen Bloons.
Place him so his range edge covers a lot of track while his aura still reaches it.
His main attack never pops Lead; his Ice Walls (level 4+) do affect Lead Bloons.

pairs.note: Ice fragments, range buffs and cheaper tier 5s.
Coldchain Skywardens benefit from his ice buffs.

name: Dan D'Monke
summary: Added in v55. A cheap support hero: Reposition moves towers, Rabble Rouser buffs nearby Monkeys and triggers life-loss passives; his alter ego adds Camo and Lead.

milestones.text: Transformation: switch to the Masqued Macaque (Camo detection and Lead popping) and back.
Occasionally throws a net that grabs Bloons.
Leaking a Bloon reduces damage taken and pushes Bloons back.
Reposition: move any Monkey, including himself (Macaque: Volant Strike).
Rabble Rouser: nearby Monkeys attack slower but harder and life-loss passives trigger (Macaque: Berserk Frenzy).

bestFor: Cheap support: Reposition substitutes for a Support Chinook, Rabble Rouser for Pat's roar, and it triggers life-loss passives (Elite Defender, x-x-2+ Desperado) in CHIMPS.
tips: His base form is usually preferred for its support; the Masqued Macaque is good in ABR for its Camo and Lead.
Use Transform's damage burst on hard grouped early rounds.
His base form has no Camo detection or Lead popping of its own; the Masqued Macaque form has both.

pairs.note: Rabble Rouser triggers Elite Defender's life-loss speed boost.
Triggers x-x-2+ Desperado life-loss passives.
